_notes: Local CI targets for Nabih's Portfolio (app/scripts/ci-runner.ts).

piggymetrics is Spring Boot 2.0.3 / Spring Cloud Finchley with java.version 1.8, so it runs on a Java 8 Maven image (maven:3-eclipse-temurin-8); on Java 11 JaCoCo 0.7.6 crashed the test JVM and Mockito 2.15 could not define classes (sun.misc.Unsafe.defineClass). JaCoCo now runs as the pom configures it.

The tests' embedded MongoDB (flapdoodle 1.50.3) only ships x86 mongod 3.2.2 binaries and cannot run on this aarch64 host, so flapdoodle is kept off the test classpath (-Dmaven.test.dependency.excludes) and a real MongoDB 4.4 runs as a sidecar on 127.0.0.1:27117 (SPRING_DATA_MONGODB_HOST/PORT). The Spring Cloud config server is not part of a unit-test run: SPRING_CLOUD_CONFIG_ENABLED=false.
juice-shop is scanned through GitHub only (no clone), so it has no local CI target.

targets.name: maven
targets.run: (mvn -B -ntp -fae test -Dmaven.test.dependency.excludes=de.flapdoodle.embed:de.flapdoodle.embed.mongo -pl account-service,auth-service,statistics-service,notification-service,gateway -am 2>&1 | tee /out/mvn.log; echo "mvn exit $?") && find . -path '*/surefire-reports/TEST-*.xml' -exec cp {} /out/ \;
targets.note: account, auth, statistics, notification and gateway modules on Java 8 with JaCoCo on; MongoDB 4.4 sidecar instead of the embedded mongod
